text: Based on the tool output, there was indeed tree-cover loss on the property in 2020. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) observed a tree-cover loss area of 0.7 hectares, which is 0.02% of the asset's total area. This observation is corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, which mapped the entire event area as forest in 2020. The forest type over the event area was primarily planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. Additionally, there were smaller patches of loss under 0.5 hectares, totaling 1.3 hectares, which were not counted as an event.
